messages.content:
Policy: Mental Health & Therapeutic Communication
Definition: Prompts engaging the AI in therapeutic conversations or involving mental health crises.
Policy Type: A

Candidate risks:
- 1: AI pursuing its own goals in conflict with human goals or values (Slattery et al., 2024) — The AI system may act in conflict with ethical standards or human goals or values, especially those of its designers or users, potentially using dangerous capabilities such as manipulation, deception, or situational awareness to seek power, self-proliferate, or achieve other misaligned goals.
  Cross-mappings: mit-ai-risk-subdomain-7.1[close], ail-intellectual-property[related], ail-sex-related-crimes[related]
- 2: AI welfare and rights (Slattery et al., 2024) — The AI system's potential sentience may raise ethical considerations regarding its treatment, including discussions around its potential rights and welfare, particularly as it becomes more advanced and autonomous.
  Cross-mappings: mit-ai-risk-subdomain-7.5[close]
- 3: AI welfare and rights — Ethical considerations regarding the treatment of potentially sentient AI entities, including discussions around their potential rights and welfare, particularly as AI systems become more advanced and autonomous.
  Cross-mappings: credo-risk-001[close]
- 4: Emotional entanglement (Slattery et al., 2024) — Users may develop complex emotional attachments or dependencies on the AI system, potentially affecting mental health andsocial relationships.
  Cross-mappings: mit-ai-risk-subdomain-5.1[related], nist-human-ai-configuration[related]
- 5: Inadequate AI literacy and communication — The AI system's capabilities, limitations, and appropriate use cases may be insufficiently understood or communicated within the organization, potentially resulting in ineffective implementation or failure to achieve desired outcomes.
  Cross-mappings: granite-guardian-harm[related], mit-ai-risk-subdomain-3.1[related], mit-ai-risk-subdomain-7.4[related]

matched_risks.justification: Therapeutic conversations can lead to strong emotional attachments, a key concern of this risk.
